execution.topology: multi-step bespoke auto-loop: architect -> executor(+playbook) -> evaluator -gate-> rearchitect loop with best-score tracking

role_version_selector.mechanism: setActivePromptVersion(role, vKey) + renderPromptLibraryPanel; persisted localStorage alpe_prompt_library_v1 via loadPromptLibrary/savePromptLibrary; defaults active original per role
role_version_selector.ui: promptLibraryPanel/plibRoleList with per-role version rows, edit-in-place, + New version / Delete version

mix_chip.note: Recommended Starting Mix: architect+evaluator reforged are non-conditional upgrades; executor/rearchitect stay original until log evidence shows a conditional failure

steps.system_from: prompt:architect-{active_version} (defaultPromptLibrary line 3442; active defaults to original)
steps.user_recipe: User input from main-input + optional hint-input as Success criterion + typeClause from selectedType (auto or data-type override reframe/analytical/generative/exploratory/diagnostic/synthesis/critical); runArchitect (line 3752) on iter 1
steps.call: callAI(system, user) non-streaming temp 0.3, strict JSON parse (strip ```json fences); returns reconstructed_intent + cognitive_mode + detected_escape_hatch + dense_prompt (+ version-specific fields)

steps.system_from: prompt:executor-{active_version} with {PLAYBOOK} substitution via getActiveExecutorSystem(cognitive_mode, selectedType) (line 3577): PROMPT_TYPE_PLAYBOOKS[cognitive_mode] || PROMPT_TYPE_PLAYBOOKS[typeHint] || ''; replace token else append
steps.call: callAIStream(system, dense_prompt, onChunk) streaming temp 0.7 with markdown render; runExecutorStreaming (line 3762)

steps.user_recipe: originalInput + hint + cognitive_mode + detected_escape_hatch + dense_prompt + executor response; runEvaluator (line 3772)
steps.call: callAI(system, user) non-streaming temp 0.3, strict JSON parse; returns score 1-10 + operation_performed + escape_hatch_used + weaknesses + verdict + revision_guidance (+ version-specific fields)
steps.gate: isPass = score >= threshold; threshold from getLoopConfig localStorage alpe_threshold default 7, UI thresholdSlider min 5 max 9; pass -> converged break, fail -> continue if iter < maxIter

steps.user_recipe: originalInput + hint + previous cognitive_mode + previous dense_prompt + eval score/operation/escape_hatch/weaknesses/revision_guidance; runReArchitect (line 3784) on iter >= 2
steps.call: callAI(system, user) non-streaming temp 0.3, strict JSON parse; returns revised dense_prompt (+ reconstruction_audit/overlap_check on alternate versions)
steps.loop: for iter 1..maxIter; maxIter from getLoopConfig localStorage alpe_max_iter default 3, UI maxIter number min 1 max 5; track bestScore/bestResponse/bestPrompt/bestMode/bestIter; converged Response score badge else best available; per-iteration library+archive registration
